pre_reactor_steps: Dissolve Fmoc-L-methionine and 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole in acetonitrile to 0.1 M concentration.
Ensure solution is exposed to air or sparged with air to saturate with O2 before entering the light zone.

proposal.chemistry_notes: Photo-oxidation of methionine to sulfoxide using 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole as photocatalyst. Oxygen is a reactant, so deoxygenation is prohibited. The reaction is fast (5 min batch), suggesting a short residence time in flow (target < 1 min) due to improved photon penetration in small ID tubing. FEP tubing is used for transparency to 420 nm light. No BPR is needed as reaction is at RT and solvent bp is high.

batch_record.reaction_description: Fmoc-L-methionine (3.7 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole (10 mol%) were dissolved in acetonitrile at 0.10 M in a round-bottom flask. The solution was exposed to air and irradiated with a 1.5 W LED centered near 420 nm at 21 C for 5 min. Fmoc-methionine sulfoxide was formed in 99% yield.
